scope: API helpers with synthetic fetch/Storage; no accepted HTTP32/backend or browser claim

results.case: Bootstrap preserves a legacy profile cursor without selecting or coercing a source
OWNER can request own metadata without a helper granting personal capabilities
A measurement PUT retains the exact body/key and never attaches an MFA grant
A401 mutation is returned once without refresh, retry or redirection
A lost mutation response is not replayed by the transport
Account replacement while a write awaits discards the late response and preserves B
Replacement during JSON decoding is fenced before the helper returns a DTO
A read can refresh once for the same logical subject
Bad UUIDs, boolean versions and unpaired query ranges send no request
Professional projection carries exact observed consent/link CAS and period
Metadata and withdrawal never accept an actor/gym tuple chosen by the helper
Storage failure prevents a mutation and remains untrusted without writing a repair pair
Reentrant account replacement during body serialization cannot send the old body as B
The new export cursor rejects uppercase while existing UUID cursor spelling remains unchanged
The one-shot JSON body rejects nonfinite numbers and oversized input before fetch
